description: For gig workers, freelancers, creators, sellers, and hosts with no employer-provided benefits, calculates a monthly set-aside for a self-funded health + retirement safety net (default 5% of income, split 60% health / 40% retirement), plus an optional emergency buffer. Mirrors platformincome.com/benefits-safety-net.html exactly. Call list_benefits_countries first if you don't already know a country's exact name.

country.description: Country name exactly as returned by list_benefits_countries, e.g. 'United States', 'Nigeria', 'India'.

emergencyPercent.description: Optional additional % of monthly income for an emergency buffer, on top of the baseline set-aside. Defaults to 0 (off).

icp.description: Which kind of platform earner this is for — only changes the wording of the per-unit breakdown, not the math.

setAsidePercent.description: Total % of monthly income to set aside. Defaults to 5% (the recommended baseline), split 60% health / 40% retirement.

name: benefits_safety_net_calculator
title: Benefits Safety Net Calculator
